Yamato: "Yeah. Knowing her, she probably wouldn't think twice
Yamato: "Why don't you go in and find out?"
Kururu: "Oh, come on! You're supposed to say, 'I'm home, honey.'"
Touya: "She could've kept that to herself..."
Kururu: "Touya, this is how people greet each other
Touya: "...In a very small number of places, maybe."
Touya: "Plenty. More to the point, this is my room.
You shouldn't just come in without asking."
Kururu: "...Anyway. Touya, take off your shirt."
Touya: "If you can't tell me, I'm not taking it off."
Kururu: "Kasumi said she sewed a button on that shirt..."
Touya: "...Oh, yeah. It was coming off.
She's good at that sort of thing..."
Kururu: "So I want to sew one on too."
Touya: "You don't have to. None of the buttons have come off."
Kururu: "I'm going to, and that's that!"
Yamato: 'She's trying so hard. Why not give it to her?'
Touya: "It's not the one Kasumi sewed on,
but could you sew this button back on for me?"
Touya: "Are you okay? Don't push yourself..."
Kururu: "I'm fine! Leave it to me!"
Touya: "Huh? Oh... Looks like it's on properly."
Touya: "More to the point, are your fingers okay?
Kururu: "Y-Yeah, I'm fine. This is nothing."
Touya: "...Honestly... Yamato, I've got some bandages in my bag.
Kururu: "I'm telling you, I'm really fine."
Touya: "...Come on, give me your hand."
Touya: "You'll have to get a little better at it."
Touya: "Otherwise, it'll be hard to ask you next time a button comes off."
Touya: "Thanks. I'm counting on you next time too."
Touya: "I'm looking forward to it, then."
Kururu: "Okay! Leave it to me! See you!"
Yamato: "For all your complaints, you don't seem to mind that much."
Touya: "I appreciate how you feel, but I don't appreciate
Touya: "No buts. If you keep throwing a tantrum like that,
I'm not going to like you anymore."
Kururu: "So... please don't stop liking me."
Kururu: "...I'm glad. I'll go now, then."
